theorems.name: Submission.doragm_rfv_radial_field_c1
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (y : Euclid P) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (A τ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ u, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) → (∀ u, A ≤ u → φ u = 0) → 0 < τ → ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x : Euclid P => φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) • (x - y)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x : Euclid P => φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) • (x - y)) ∧ tsupport (fun x : Euclid P => φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) • (x - y)) ⊆ closedBall y (A * τ)
